data.name: Death of a Thousand Cuts
data.description: Members of your collective gain a bonus to damage rolls against their targets equal to the number of collective members flanking that target. For example, if you and three of your collective members are all flanking one creature, each collective member gains a +4 bonus on damage rolls against that target.

raw_tokens.value: Swarmer ~ Death of a Thousand Cuts

Members of your collective gain a bonus to damage rolls against their targets equal to the number of collective members flanking that target. For example, if you and three of your collective members are all flanking one creature, each collective member gains a +4 bonus on damage rolls against that target.
